title: YOUR BUYER WAS PREAPPROVED 30 DAYS AGO. THE MARKET WASN'T.
subtitle: Reassess payment scenarios to ensure your buyers are prepared for today's market conditions. Stay proactive with UFF's PRO Portal.
keyTakeaways: Verify current home prices before proceeding.
Run updated financing scenarios in PRO Portal.
Present new estimated payments to borrowers.
Ensure borrower comfort with current payments.
Utilize PRO Portal for seamless scenario updates.

sections.heading: Why Refresh Scenarios?
sections.body: The market can shift significantly in 30 days. A preapproval is not immune to these changes. Use PRO Portal to ensure your clients are aligned with current market realities.
bullets: Align buyer perception with market conditions.

sections.heading: Steps to Update Financing Scenarios
sections.body: Log into PRO Portal to access live rate updates and price loans with accuracy. Utilize this tool to ensure all aspects of the loan align with today's rates and conditions.

sections.heading: Ensuring Borrower Comfort
sections.body: Beyond qualification, comfort with the payment is key. Discuss updated payment estimates with your clients and address any concerns.

metaDescription: Refresh borrower scenarios in UFF's PRO Portal to align with current market conditions. Ensure comfort beyond preapproval.
